FN-MBMUHH1-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 222
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/29/2024
Senate Bill 222 as passed the Senate would expressly allow the Alabama Board of Nursing to
use gifts and grants for counseling or evaluation services for applicants or licenses of the board.
This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
